HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette:? (1 mark)
   A. Use General Etiquette: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette:.
   C. Say General Etiquette: has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji? (1 mark)
   A. Say Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Myself [? (1 mark)
   A. Use Myself [ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Myself [ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Myself [ has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Myself [.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Basic Prayers? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Basic Prayers with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Basic Prayers to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Basic Prayers has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Basic Prayers.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Religious? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Religious.
   B. Use Religious to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Religious with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Religious has no place in daily life.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

7. Which response best shows understanding of Qualities Of Enlightened Beings? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Qualities Of Enlightened Beings.
   B. Say Qualities Of Enlightened Beings has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Qualities Of Enlightened Beings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Qualities Of Enlightened Beings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

9. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.
   C. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
